description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987 Act No. 15 of 1987 Extend of the Gazette No. 2318/41-2023
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of a permitted period under specific legal provisions (Provincial Council Act No. 12 of 1989 and Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 15 of 1987). It is a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and the exercise of powers vested by law, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
